Set a daily usage budget for this app.\n\nOnce you\'ve used the app for this many minutes today, it switches to a hard block for the rest of the day. The block lands as soon as the budget runs out, even if you\'re still inside the app.

\n\nThis budget counts time in the app only. Once it runs out the websites below are hard-blocked as well, but time spent on them does not yet count towards it -- use Auto-kick\'s time trigger to limit the websites.
Displays remaining daily time as a floating overlay.\n\nChanges color as time runs out: green (>50%), orange (25-50%), red (<25%).

Shows a floating counter while you use this app.

Sends you to the home screen after a set number of scrolls/taps, or after a set amount of time in the app -- whichever fires first.\n\nThe counter and timer reset when you re-open the app. This is the nuclear option for stopping infinite scroll.
\n\nThe time trigger also covers the websites below -- each site gets its own timer and its own cooldown. The interaction trigger is app-only.
While %1$s is blocked, Nudge covers the %1$s tab in Instagram\'s bottom bar, so the icon is not there and tapping it does nothing. The rest of Instagram works as normal.

Experimental. When you open Instagram\'s home feed, Nudge switches it to Following, so you see posts from people you follow rather than suggested ones. You can switch back at any time. If Instagram changes its layout this quietly stops working.
This will delete all rules for %1$s. The app will no longer be blocked.
